name: Classroom AI Proxy
description: A kid-safe proxy that lets students use AI in Colab without an API key.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your REAL OpenAI API key. Held only on the server; students never see it.

CLASSROOM_SECRET.description: Shared classroom password students type into their notebooks.

ALLOWED_MODEL.description: Model every request is forced to use (cost control).

MAX_TOKENS_CAP.description: Hard ceiling on max_tokens per request.

RATE_LIMIT_MAX.description: Max requests per student/IP within the window.
